Remote' at AI2) against an SF-hybrid seat, and the AI2 stint ended about three months before this capture, right when the stealth-founder listing starts — the packet doesn't say whether he's actually on the market or mid-build/fundraise for his own org, so I can't call comp or retention yet. ai_evaluator.text: PACKET FACT: the disambiguation rule's three named tests hold up on inspection — weight-changing post-training via 'Tulu 3: Pushing Frontiers in Open Language Model Post-Training' (first author, 1481 cites, covers SFT/DPO/RLVR) plus TRL ('Transformer reinforcement learning,' co-author on the library the field trains RLHF with) and OLMo/OLMo 2/OLMo 3 co-authorship; production research Python via TRL itself (1066-cite github entry) and 'dgx-spark-setup' (CUDA 13, GB10 Blackwell, current systems work); metric-scepticism/trace-level judgment via RewardBench ('the first evaluation tool for reward models,' first author) which is literally the JD's language — 'whether a metric measures the thing that matters' — applied to reward models. INFERENCE: but that judgment is demonstrated on model outputs and reward-model preference data, never on multi-step agent transcripts, and the 'agent harness as tunable surface — tools, subagents, retrieval, validation loops' half of the IS section has zero footprint across 25+ repos and 20 top papers; a packet this dense (full GitHub history since 2017, full pub list) is detailed enough that harness/agent-orchestration work would likely show if it existed at Build depth, so this leans EVIDENCE OF ABSENCE rather than absence-of-evidence, though it's plausible his AI2/HF research-scientist roles simply never required it. PACKET FACT: vintage is excellent and current — 'Never Give Up' GRPO post 1 week ago, Spurious Rewards (RLVR) 2025, OLMo 3 2025/2026 — this is not a stale record. So the single most important gap is not availability (people_partner's question) but capability shape: strong, current, hands-on general-purpose LLM post-training plus reward-model evaluation, with no visible evidence of agent-harness/tool/subagent engineering or judgment on agentic (versus generative) traces, which the JD treats as core, not nice-to-have.
